# Filters

A filtration component that helps users refine content by selecting criteria. A neutral trigger button opens a floating panel of filter blocks (search, checkbox lists with show more, chips, ranges); applied filters appear as primary buttons with a remove action. Rebuilt to match the DGA library's dga-filteration anatomy, composed from the design-system button, checkbox, chip, search box, and text input components.

**Stylesheet:** `components/filters/filters.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/filters.js` (classes `FilterManager`); wired through `[data-filteration-toggle]`, `[data-show-more]`, `[data-apply]`, `[data-clear]`, `[data-remove-filter]`, `[data-option]`, `[data-filter-search]`. Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes, mapped from the library's dga-filteration API.

| Class | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.filteration` | Base | — | Column container: trigger + applied-filters row, with the floating panel anchored to it. |
| Trigger button | Composition | `button-label` | A design-system .btn.btn-neutral (large) with a leading filter icon and a trailing chevron, both white. |
| `.filteration__selected-filters` | Element | `selected-filters` | Applied filters as primary .btn.btn-primary buttons with a trailing × that removes them. New entries fade in. |
| .filteration__panel [+ .is-open] | Element | `is-filter-panel-open` | Floating 320px panel: 8px radius, gray-300 border, soft shadow, slide-down entrance, 75vh scroll. On mobile it centers as a fixed sheet. |
| .filteration__block / __block-title | Element | `filter-blocks` | One filter group: 14px semibold title, gray-50 hover, 20px start indent, divider below. |
| `.filteration__block-content--checkbox\|--radio\|--chips\|--select` | Modifier | `block.type` | Layout per block type; checkbox blocks show 3 options collapsed. |
| `.filteration__search` | Element | — | A design-system search box that filters the block's options as you type. |
| `.filteration__block-actions` | Element | — | "Show N more / Show less" — a transparent button with a chevron, shown when a checkbox block has more than 5 options. |
| `.filteration__range` | Element | `block.type="range"` | Two 125px text inputs joined by a dash. |
| `.filteration__actions` | Element | — | Apply filters (neutral) + Clear filters (secondary outline), end-aligned, min-width 120px, above a gray-200 top border. |

## Trigger & Applied Filters

The neutral trigger with its filter icon and chevron, next to applied filters rendered as primary buttons with a remove ×.

```html
<div class="filteration" style="max-width: 640px;">
    <div class="filteration__toolbar">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-neutral">
            <span class="icon dga-icon-filter"></span>
            Filter Products
            <span class="icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01"></span>
        </button>
        <div class="filteration__selected-filters">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">
                Electronics
                <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">
                In stock
                <span class="icon dga-icon-multiplication-sign"></span>
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Panel

The open panel: a search box, a checkbox block collapsed to three options with a "Show more" action, a divider, and the Apply / Clear actions.

```html
<div class="filteration__panel is-open" style="position: static; animation: none;">
    <div class="filteration__block">
        <h3 class="filteration__block-title">Category</h3>
        <div class="filteration__search">
            <div class="search-box">
                <span class="search-box__icon"><span class="icon dga-icon-search-01"></span></span>
                <input type="text" class="search-box__field" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search options">
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="filteration__block-content filteration__block-content--checkbox">
            <label class="checkbox">
                <div class="checkbox__row">
                    <div class="checkbox__control">
                        <input type="checkbox" class="checkbox__input" checked="">
                        <span class="checkbox__box"><svg class="checkbox__icon checkbox__icon--check" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                <path d="M10 3L4.5 8.5L2 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.67" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span>
                    </div>
                    <span class="checkbox__label">Electronics</span>
                </div>
            </label>
            <label class="checkbox">
                <div class="checkbox__row">
                    <div class="checkbox__control">
                        <input type="checkbox" class="checkbox__input">
                        <span class="checkbox__box"><svg class="checkbox__icon checkbox__icon--check" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                <path d="M10 3L4.5 8.5L2 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.67" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span>
                    </div>
                    <span class="checkbox__label">Clothing</span>
                </div>
            </label>
            <label class="checkbox">
                <div class="checkbox__row">
                    <div class="checkbox__control">
                        <input type="checkbox" class="checkbox__input">
                        <span class="checkbox__box"><svg class="checkbox__icon checkbox__icon--check" viewBox="0 0 12 12" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                <path d="M10 3L4.5 8.5L2 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.67" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path></svg></span>
                    </div>
                    <span class="checkbox__label">Books</span>
                </div>
            </label>
        </div>
        <div class="filteration__block-actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-transparent btn-medium">
                Show 3 more
                <span class="icon dga-icon-arrow-down-01"></span>
            </button>
        </div>
        <div class="filteration__divider"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="filteration__actions">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-neutral">Apply filters</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Clear filters</button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Block Types

Beyond checkboxes: chips blocks wrap design-system chips at a 20px gap, and range blocks join two 125px text inputs with a dash.

```html
<div class="filteration__panel is-open" style="position: static; animation: none;">
    <div class="filteration__block">
        <h3 class="filteration__block-title">Size</h3>
        <div class="filteration__block-content filteration__block-content--chips">
            <button type="button" class="chip chip-neutral chip-medium">Small</button>
            <button type="button" class="chip chip-neutral chip-medium selected">Medium</button>
            <button type="button" class="chip chip-neutral chip-medium">Large</button>
        </div>
        <div class="filteration__block-actions"></div>
        <div class="filteration__divider"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="filteration__block">
        <h3 class="filteration__block-title">Price range</h3>
        <div class="filteration__block-content">
            <div class="filteration__range">
                <div class="text-input"><input type="text" class="text-input__field" placeholder="Min" aria-label="Minimum price"></div>
                <span>—</span>
                <div class="text-input"><input type="text" class="text-input__field" placeholder="Max" aria-label="Maximum price"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="filteration__block-actions"></div>
        <div class="filteration__divider"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="filteration__actions">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-neutral">Apply filters</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Clear filters</button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## RTL Layout

```html

            <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">
```
